Online Admission

Important notice for Admission(2025-26)

All the students are informed that after filling the application form
online on the college website for admission, make sure to submit its
printout along with the photocopies of all the documents in the office,
otherwise their application will not be considered.

for more information for Admission 2025-26 click here

As per the University guidelines, the prospectus and registration fee
for the session 2025-26 are open. The candidates have to pay through an
online payment mode to complete the registration process for admission.

बीए प्रथम सेमेस्टर में प्रवेश हेतु विषय चयन संबंधी निर्देश

1. If admission test is conducted by the college for admission of the
students to B.A, M.A.,B.Ed.(First year), then the admission will be
based on the basis of merit list of entrance examinations along with the
academic and additional marks set by the University.

 

2. Any type of cutting or sub-writing on the admission application form
will not be permissible. 

 

3. Entrants are required to complete the admission process according to
the dates specified in the entry lists and deposit the charges
accordingly. After the specified dates are over, no entry for admission
will be given again. Payment gateway charges would be applicable.

  -------------- ----------------- ------------------------- -----------------
  Payment Mode   Gateway charges   Payment Mode              Gateway charges
  CC             1.1%              HDFC NB                   INR 25
  DC             1.1%              Kotak Bank NB             INR 25
  DC Rupay       0.50%             Jammu & Kashmir Bank NB   1%
  SBI NB         INR 25            Other NB                  INR 15
  Axis NB        INR 25            UPI                       INR 5-9
  ICICI NB       INR 25            EMI                        
  -------------- ----------------- ------------------------- -----------------

4. The applicant will have to fill the application form. The application
form will be cancelled if there is an error in the application, and the
applicant will have to hold all the responsibility in case of any
errors.

 

5. The details and number of attachments, which are attached with the
application, should be clearly mentioned in the application form. The
applicant’s own signature must be there on the attachment. Students
should ensure that all the enclosures are arranged, depending on the
qualification and merit counts. When registering the application, don’t
attach the original copy of T.C. and C.C.

 

6. It is compulsory to attach the xerox copy of the application form for
each entrant and even attach the Xerox copy of Aadhar Enrolment card or
Aadhar nomination card with the application form.

 

7. The list of selected candidates for admission in the first year
graduate and post-graduate courses will be announced in the college
notice board after the registration and admission test.

 

8. No information will be sent by post to any selected candidates or
through any other medium. Therefore, according to the information
provided on the notice board of the college, the selected candidates
should be admitted in the specified time period, otherwise the right to
get admission will automatically be cancelled and the process of entry
for admission will be passed to other candidates based on the vacancy.

 

9. Applicants seeking admission in any of the courses in the college
will have to fill in their email address and telephone/ mobile number in
the application form. Applicants who do not have an e-mail address must
be sure to have an email address before filling the application form so
that the important college information can be shared easily.

 

10. Any type of cutting or sub-writing on the entry card will not be
permissible.

 

11. The student will have his own responsibility to calculate the marks
himself and if there is any error in the qualifying marks mentioned in
the admission list, then inform the Admission Officer in writing. If
there is any error in the merit marks by the college, then it can be
corrected by amending it and if the admission is done due to incorrect
marks, then it can be cancelled at any time by the Principal and in such
a case the fee can not refunded.

About Us

Welcome To BNKB POSTGRADUATE COLLEGE AKBARPUR

Established in 1969, BNKB Postgraduate College, Akbarpur, has been a
beacon of higher education, nurturing generations of students with a
commitment to academic excellence and holistic development. The
foundation of the institution was laid by Late Vishweshwar Nath Hangal,
a visionary advocate and landlord, who initially established
Anglovernakuiler Middle School to promote modern education. Over the
years, the institution expanded and evolved, achieving the status of an
intermediate college.

Through the generous contributions of Mr. Kailas Bihari Mehra, the
college embarked on its journey in July 1969 and was subsequently named
Vishweshwar Nath Kailash Bihari Mahavidyalaya. Today, it operates under
an affiliated committee, with Mr. Suresh Nath Kapoor serving as Chairman
and Mr. Krishna Kumar Tandon as Minister.

BNKB Postgraduate College upholds the glorious national traditions and
cultural values of Akbarpur while striving to instill intellectual,
physical, and spiritual empowerment in its students. The institution is
dedicated to fostering knowledge, wisdom, and moral integrity, guided by
the motto:
